name: GAZTRANSP.TECHNIG.EO-,01
summary: Gaztransport & Technigaz (GTT) is an engineering company specializing in membrane containment systems for the transportation and storage of liquefied natural gas (LNG). The company designs and licenses technologies for LNG carriers and onshore storage tanks. Gaztransport & Technigaz is headquartered in Saint-Rémy-lès-Chevreuse, France.
